verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any LiteLLM setting for opting out of vendor telemetry or usage tracking. The only related item (litellm-docs-12) is a different control: it stops message and response content from going to the user's own logging provider, and it states that request metadata such as spend is still tracked. That is an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
